# VK

> > VK is Russia's leading social network and technology platform offering ticketing services, voice assistant capabilities, and mini apps ecosystem.

VK provides a comprehensive digital ecosystem including VK Билеты (VK Tickets) for event ticketing and live entertainment, and Маруся (Marusia), a voice assistant with skills for task management and productivity. The platform supports VK Mini Apps for browser-based applications and serves the Russian-speaking market with localized services.

## Key Topics

- VK Билеты (VK Tickets)
- Маруся (Marusia voice assistant)
- VK Mini Apps
- Concert ticketing
- Live music events
- Voice assistant skills
- Task management
- Russian pop music
- 5sta Family
- Event booking
- Browser applications
- Recurring tasks
- Goal tracking

## Event Ticketing

- [5sta Family Concert in Ivanovo](https://tickets.vk.com/ivanovo/event/5sta-family-1121912): Purchase tickets for 5sta Family concert at Руки Вверх Бар Иваново on April 25, 2026 at 18:00 through VK Билеты ticketing platform

## Voice Assistant & Skills

- [Погнали Task Planner Skill](https://marusia.vk.com/skill/54471894): Task planning and management skill for Маруся voice assistant with recurring tasks and goal tracking capabilities
